t: Radio for the Pi ground station / Navi restarts by itself when sending fails or the Wi-Fi mode changes (e.g. car hotspot switched off after joining home Wi-Fi)
System info: radio counters (sent, errors, restarts) for checking the ground station link

Pi ground station without Wi-Fi: the Core sends battery, temperatures, wet sensor and warning limits twice per second by radio (ESP-NOW broadcast) – the ground station hears it directly, no pairing, the Navi is not affected
Header bar: LQ (link quality) next to RSSI – green, red below the LQ warning threshold
LQ warning: only sensible values (0 = off or 20–90 %, delay 0–10 s) plus a short note which value fits
Link quality warning has its own delay: Telemetry → Radio link → Must stay below for at least (s), default 1 s, 0 = immediately (no longer the battery time). In /api/cfg and config.txt as lqWarnSek
Link quality warning moved to Telemetry → Radio link (ELRS), next to the live LQ. The LQ tile turns red below this threshold

Battery page: new setting Link quality warning below … % (default 50 %, 0 = off). If the receiver LQ stays below it for the set time: WEAK LINK x % on OSD and display. Also in config.txt and /api/cfg (lqWarnPct) for the Pi ground station
Test GPS (VGPS) and the home position of the maps now sit exactly on the house
Maps & rides → Load maps → Coordinates or map link: plus codes work too (e.g. 5JM6+QFJ St. Pölten from Apple or Google Maps)
Fix: GPS → Packets per second sometimes showed 0 /s (or double) – now calculated each time the FC reports a new packet count
Switch Test GPS (VGPS) at home is now only on the GPS page (removed from Wi-Fi)

New page GPS: module, fix, satellites, HDOP, position, VGPS switch; communication FC ↔ GPS (packets per second, errors and timeouts per minute); chart of the last 5 minutes. The GPS card moved from Telemetry to this page
Wi-Fi → Home Wi-Fi: new switch Test GPS (VGPS) at home – off = the Core never shows the test position, only the real GPS
High beam is always off while the transmitter is off (no receiver signal / failsafe). With signal: as before
Display → After arm: new choice Animation from SD card – plays an animation from /anim/ on the SD card in a loop while armed (with Test animation 12 s)
7 new animations come with this update onto the SD card: Demon eyes, Neon eyes, Shadow at the window, Radar, Hyperspace, Heartbeat, Glitch logo
Fix: Display → Test update screen now really shows the update picture for 6 s
